nom: BLUME Meltdown Gel Cream for Acne-Prone Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combo skin report the gel cream hydrates without adding greasiness or shine, and several say it helps control oil through the day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including in winter or arid climates, describe it as sufficiently moisturizing and non-tacky, though one reviewer notes very dry skin may need a richer product at night.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it balances oily and dry zones (T-zone vs cheeks) without clogging pores, though one describes it drying slightly tacky.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say it is gentle, non-irritating and does not react despite the fragrance, while a minority report redness, rash, or burning that made the product unusable.
segments.mature: The few mature-skin reviewers (50s, using tretinoin) report it layers well under makeup, feels rich, and helps with hormonal breakouts and blocked pores without extra oiliness.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer using prescription tretinoin reports the cream feels rich, calming, and pairs well with actives without added irritation.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across skin types report noticeable, lasting hydration and softer skin, including in dry winter climates; one reviewer with very dry skin still felt she needed a heavier product at night.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or calming effects, including one specifically noting it works well under retinoids; however, others report the product itself caused new redness, rash, or an inflamed reaction.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers pairing this with retinoids or actives report it supports the skin barrier and reduces irritation and dryness from those products.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing, and reduced hyperpigmentation from acne marks over weeks of use; a smaller group reports no improvement or new spots appearing.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report the product does not break them out and even helps clear hormonal or cystic acne over time; however, a distinct group reports significant new breakouts—cystic pimples, whiteheads, comedones—shortly after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin consistently report it moisturizes without increasing shine or oiliness, and some say it helps control oil production.

aspects.libelle: New pump packaging hard to use
Container wastes product, no jar option
Good value for price and longevity

extraits.texte: It made my face turn very red and rash out that my oblivious boyfriend even noticed it :,( it looked like I had a burn to my face. I do have super sensitive skin. I can't use many popular skin products except Kate Somerville.

So wanted to love this- I've been using the meltdown oil and quite like it, and do think it's helping with my acne. This cream has broken me out like crazy though! Tons of whiteheads and cystic pimples. So disappointing 😞 I can't keep using it, will have to give it away. A shame because it feels so nice on, and the smell is divine!

I'm on my second bottle of this and I use it underneath a heavier moisturizer. This is amazing for irritation and redness associate with retinoids. It instantly calms my skin and cuts down dramatically on my irritation and dynness. If I wasn't using strong retinoids this might be enough on it's own, but it pairs nice with other thicker creams but gives all the ceramides for barrier. Love it and love the very light natural cotton candy scent. No breakouts, no irritation but lightweight hydration

I have acne prone skin that for the most part is quite dry but I struggle often with blackheads in my T-zone area. So it can be difficult for me to find a lightweight moisturizer for the summer months that won't exacerbate blackheads but also won't leave me with dry patches. This moisturizer is the perfect lightweight acne-friendly product that still does a fantastic job of keeping my dry skin moisturized and hydrated! And the SMELL is AMAZING. I have very sensitive skin and the fragrance does not irritate it at all which was a really nice surprise! And a little goes a long way with this product! One pump covers my entire face. I would highly recommend giving this moisturizer a try!

extraits.titre: Lightweight moisturizer that hydrates without clogging pores
extraits.texte: I've been using this gel cream for a few weeks now, and it's quickly become my go-to daily moisturizer. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs almost instantly, so it never feels heavy or greasy on the skin. What I love most is how well it balances hydration with acne care. It keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day without clogging my pores or causing new breakouts. Ingredients like ceramides and squalane help support the skin barrier, while niacinamide and centella asiatica work to calm redness and even out my skin tone . It layers really nicely under sunscreen and makeup, and my skin feels soft, smooth, and calm after using it. It's especially great if you have combination or acne-prone skin and want hydration without heaviness. The only thing to note is that if you have very dry skin, you might need something a bit richer at night. Also, it has a slight scent, which may not be ideal for extremely sensitive skin. Overall, this is a great everyday moisturizer that delivers hydration while still being gentle on breakout-prone skin.

I am not gonna lie. I hardly ever review products AND I'm extremely skeptical. I am 54. I take care of my skin. I use prescription tretinoin, sunscreen and moisturizers. I still get hormonal breakouts and blocked pores. This gorgeous blue tansy tinted cream feels like butter and my skin loves it. Makeup glides on over it and when I apply at night my skin is moist and clear in the morning

extraits.titre: Creamy, rich, and pleasant—but perhaps better for Winter use
extraits.texte: I live in arid Colorado and have been using this for about a month now. It's creamy and absorbs quickly without leaving an oily residue. The smell is pleasant and my combo skin seems to generally be happy from using it. That said, I think that this would be better for winter and Whirl better for summer (because this is thicker and richer than Whirl). I do recommend trying it out!
